git_log.message: Refs #36593, #37187 -- Avoided spurious select_related() warning in ModelAdmin.
Fixed #37143 -- Added missing chunk_size=None check to QuerySet.aiterator().
Refs #37097 -- Removed compilation-time order clearing on combined queries on Oracle.
Fixed #36593 -- Deprecated QuerySet.select_related() with no arguments.
Fixed #37016 -- Avoided propagating invalid arguments from When() to Q().

code_rationale.comment: __aiter__() is a *synchronous* method that has to then return an *asynchronous* iterator/generator. Thus, nest an async generator inside it. This is a generic iterable converter for now, and is going to suffer a performance penalty on large sets of items due to the cost of crossing over the sync barrier for each chunk. Custom __aiter__() methods should be added to each Iterable subclass, but that needs some work in the Compiler first.
Avoid overwriting objects loaded by, e.g., select_related().
Avoid fetching potentially deferred attributes that would result in unexpected queries.
Cache some things for performance reasons outside the loop.
extra(select=...) cols are always at the start of the row.
